title: Fix misplaced doc comment between clamp_u32 and get_or_create_uidvalidity in mailbox.rs
description: In session/mailbox.rs around lines 225-242, the doc comment for get_or_create_uidvalidity is split across two functions. The opening sentence ("Get or create the UIDVALIDITY and UIDNEXT for a mailbox.") appears as part of the doc comment on clamp_u32, and the continuation ("On first access, generates UIDVALIDITY from the current Unix timestamp") is dangling between the two functions. rustdoc will attribute the opening sentence to clamp_u32 and orphan the rest. The doc comment needs to be consolidated onto get_or_create_uidvalidity, with clamp_u32 getting its own complete standalone doc comment.
